plan.p0: A fixed local rule may replace every 2 with a five-cell horizontal motif centered on that cell: [1,5,5,5,5] spanning two cells left through two right. It may overwrite any contents in the span. This fits the observed 2-to-motif conversions; its distinguishing assumption is fixed colors and unconditional stamping.
plan.p1: A collision-aware rule may center [1,5,5,5,5] on each 2 but write only into background cells, preserving any nonbackground cells already present. The observed pre-existing motif remains intact, while the 2-centered motifs appear in empty space. It differs from p0 on overlaps, borders, or occupied spans.
plan.p2: The transformation may copy a pre-existing five-cell horizontal template rather than use fixed colors: each 2 marks the center position of a copied template, with its leftmost cell two columns earlier. The observed template is [1,5,5,5,5]. A different existing template or palette would therefore change the prediction.
plan.p3: A selective rule may expand only markers lying in otherwise uniform background rows, placing the observed five-cell motif around each qualifying 2 and leaving other cells unchanged. This matches the training arrangement but assumes row context matters; markers in patterned or mixed rows of another input could remain single cells.
